# AMZN — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q1 2026 earnings (April 29 after close) fired and are fully priced — historic EPS beat ($2.78 vs $1.64) triggered a "sell the news" shooting star on April 30. No new binary catalyst within 10 trading days. Amazon Ads Upfront (May 11, NYC) is the nearest event — ad-showcase, not a binary catalyst. Q2 2026 earnings estimated July 30. New structural positives since last run: BNP Paribas raised price target post-Q1, OpenAI deepened AWS partnership (pivoting from Azure). Analyst consensus remains strongly bullish (avg PT $311.65, 45B/2H/0S). Macro: WTI eased to $104.10 (-2.22%) on May 5 as Iran-US deal talks remain on the table per Defense Sec. Hegseth; geopolitical tail risk not removed. [source: web_research/AMZN.json, run 20260505_173521]

---

| Q2 2026 Earnings | ~July 30, 2026 (after close, unconfirmed) | High — next binary; Q2 consensus EPS $1.82, revenue $188.96B |
| US midterm elections | November 2026 | Low-medium — tech/cloud regulation uncertainty |
| Iran-U.S. conflict (live) | Ongoing | High — WTI $104.10/bbl (easing); Strait of Hormuz closure remains tail risk for AWS energy costs |

---

## Q1 2026 earnings synthesis (fired — fully priced)

**Beat magnitude:** EPS $2.78 vs $1.64 estimate (+$1.14, 69.5% upside surprise). Revenue $181.5B (~2% above consensus). AWS $37.6B (+28% YoY). AWS backlog surged 50% QoQ to ~$365B (ex-Anthropic deal). Q2 2026 revenue guide $194-199B; operating income $20-24B. [source: web_research/AMZN.json]

**Market reaction:** "Sell the news" — price gapped to $273.88 on April 30, closed at $265.06. Bearish shooting star on 2.05x average volume. Entire +27% pre-earnings run was implied consensus. Prior AMZN short (run 20260501_173921) entered on this signal; stopped out May 4 at $276 (P&L -$10.14, ID 115).

---

## Structural positives absorbed into current price

**OpenAI-AWS partnership deepened:** OpenAI is shifting aggressively from Microsoft Azure toward Amazon AWS. Companies with large AWS commitments can more easily adopt OpenAI models. This is a material competitive win over Microsoft. [source: web_research/AMZN.json, CNBC April 29, 2026]

**Amazon Supply Chain Services:** Launched for all external businesses — described as "AWS of Logistics." UPS and FedEx shares fell 8-9% on the announcement. Structural positive for Amazon's logistics margin diversification. [source: web_research/AMZN.json, CNBC/Motley Fool May 4, 2026]

**Globalstar acquisition ($11.57B):** Second-largest deal in company history — satellite connectivity optionality for logistics and rural delivery. Long-term positive, not a near-term price catalyst.

**$200B AI capex plan:** Live bearish overhang — analyst cash-flow scrutiny ongoing. [source: web_research/AMZN.json]

## What would reactivate entry conditions

- **Pullback to $258-265 (10 EMA zone):** Trend-momentum and macro-context agents would re-engage with ~3.5:1 R/R long entry.
- **Confirmed daily close above $276 on 1.5x+ volume:** Breakout long entry ~$276.50, measured move target $296.
- **Hourly RSI-21 >75 + volume-confirmed rejection candle at $273-276:** Mean-reversion short entry ~$272-273, target $257, stop $277, R/R ~2.5:1.
- **Iran ceasefire:** Durable de-escalation removes energy cost tail risk and restores clean risk-on bid for AMZN AI premium.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
